info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Parking Reservations Checkouts-v3-spec
info.description: The Parking Reservations Checkout API allows users to retrieve detailed information about parking reservation checkouts. This endpoint is designed for stakeholders needing visibility into current and past reservations, facilitating effective management and tracking of parking resources. Typical consumers include parking operators, developers of parking management systems, and customer service teams seeking to assist clients. By utilizing this API, users can enhance their operational efficiency and improve the customer experience through informed decision-making.

get.summary: Retrieve the checkout information for reservations.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to retrieve the checkout details for existing reservations, including any associated pricing and availability data, to facilitate a smooth checkout experience for users.
